knownIssues: Web farm rejects ~50% of POSTs with ViewState MAC error. Retry up to 5 times built into existing content script.

register.interaction: Two paths: V1 manual XLSX import, V1.5 automated capture (mirror of digitallocks pattern).

v1.userAction: Click Export → Excel in Power BI, drag .xlsx into dashboard

parserPlan.detectRegisterRows: First column cells parseable as register numbers
parserPlan.parseCells: Signed dollar amount (negative = short, positive = over). Blank = no transaction.
parserPlan.preserveTotals: Totals row stored separately, NOT included in normalized rows

v1_5.signatureToProbe: Body contains a Property name matching the register column (e.g. 'Register', 'Register Number') AND a date property
v1_5.drillThroughQuery: Separate DAX query fired on cell click, captures operator detail

auth.scope: Power BI tenant scope (capture-and-replay only; bearer never decoded or stored)
